_comment: Manual status overrides. Status is normally DERIVED from git — merged to
develop = done, open PR = in-review, pushed branch = in-progress. Use this
file only when reality and git genuinely disagree.
Every override needs a reason. An override without one is how a plan starts
reporting what people wish were true.
Valid status values: todo | in-progress | in-review | done | blocked

A-001.reason: Maven multi-module skeleton (common/domain/api/worker) builds green; landed before the task-ID commit convention

A-002.reason: docker-compose.yml verified running MySQL 8.4 + Redis + MinIO + Mailpit; predates the task-ID commit convention

A-007.reason: V20260805_1106__baseline_masters_ops.sql applied and verified; landed inside the A-004/A-005 commit

A-008.reason: V20260805_1107__immutability_triggers.sql applied; all six triggers verified rejecting UPDATE/DELETE against live MySQL 8.4

A-009.reason: V20260805_1108__generated_columns_and_indexes.sql applied; pcd_open and current_ticket_id generated columns plus FULLTEXT confirmed

A-011.reason: .github/workflows/ci.yml green — migration guard, backend verify, frontend build, OpenAPI staleness, single-jar packaging

A-010.reason: Shivendra, commit 0518564 — docker/grants/apply-app-grants.sql grants edutrack_app SELECT+INSERT only on the three append-only tables, and withholds GRANT OPTION from edutrack_migrate. Commit subject said 'A011' without the hyphen, so git could not match it

A-013.reason: Shivendra, commit 0518564 — SchemaIntegrationIT covers update/delete rejection on ticket_history and ticket_effort_logs, delete and non-seal update rejection on ticket_stage_transitions, and seal-succeeds-exactly-once, on Testcontainers. Supersedes the earlier hand-verification; commit subject said 'A011' without the hyphen

D-053.reason: Debashis — git reads this as done, and the backlog entry says otherwise in its own first line: search shipped, the other two are blocked. File/image share has nowhere to put the row (ticket_attachments.ticket_id is NOT NULL, so an attachment on a DM or project channel is unrepresentable) and no storage layer — C-024/C-025 own upload, MinIO keys, MIME sniffing and AV scan, and a second pipeline here would put two answers next to each other for 'is this file safe'. Needs Divyansh's sign-off on the table shape. Emoji has no backend at all and belongs to S-25's composer

A-030.reason: Shivendra, PR #87 merged 2026-08-11 — features/auth/ with LoginPage, ForgotPassword, ResetPassword, ChangePassword, authStore, RequireAuth and the strength meter, verified against the real stack (MySQL, Redis, packaged jar, Vite proxy with VITE_USE_MOCKS=false), and checked off in STREAM-A-PLATFORM.md. Commit subject carried no task ID and the merge subject only had the lowercase branch slug 'a-030', which the [A-D]-\d{3} pattern does not match

A-044.reason: Not started — no verifier exists in worker/, and the backlog entry is unchecked. Git reads it as done because PR #123 (2026-08-14) merged a docs commit whose subject read 'record the A-042 decisions and the two gaps A-044 inherits'. The subject was describing what the verifier will inherit, not finishing it, but the parser cannot tell those apart — the fifth time this has happened after A-010, A-013, D-045 and D-053. A reworded subject naming only A-042 was pushed and lost the race with the merge by minutes
